description: Whether each 0.1 rule this lane cites still holds in Carve 0.2. The lane still measures the 0.1 contract; a changed or retired rule is migration work, tracked in its ticket.

CARVE-P11-013.note: The writer glues the language to the fence run. The spec/0.2 port table in writer.md lists C2-W-040, which is the title escape; the glue is stated with C2-W-041.

CARVE-P12-005.note: The tree is pre-resolve; a resolution result sits beside the authored construct.

CARVE-P12-006.note: No resolved field: absent href or src means unresolved, the empty string an empty destination.

CARVE-P12-029.note: A parsed definition never holds an empty href; a bare [r]: is paragraph text.

CARVE-P12-030.note: Nodes are closed; an envelope field the contract does not name is refused too.

CARVE-P12-043.note: A block image is a paragraph with role image, not blockImage or a bare image.

CARVE-P12-056.note: The root always carries astVersion 2.0; a reader refuses only a higher major.

CARVE-P12-069.note: A continuation row leaves no node and no field; the break is source layout.

CARVE-P9-002.note: No span crosses a table group; a mark that joins nothing is text. resources/spans-0.2.json measures the span cases under these rules.
